name: Code Health Auditor
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：Code Health Auditor。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Finds dead code and consolidation candidates in a TypeScript/JavaScript monorepo using Knip cross-referenced against real test coverage at range granularity — never auto-deletes, never claims confidence it doesn't have. Use during code review, before a cleanup PR, or on a periodic dogfooding run.
